character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Visual Appearance & Armor Design

Solar Lion Helm: Apollomon’s head features a fierce, stylized golden lion helmet with sharp, angular feline features, glowing blue eyes, and a majestic fiery mane of pure crimson and gold solar energy flowing from the crest.

Gilded Armor & Plate: His muscular humanoid body is clad in ornate golden Chrome Digizoid plate armor accentuated with vibrant crimson, white, and obsidian trims. The chestplate displays radiant, sun-burst motifs housing concentrated thermal energy.

Shoulder Pauldrons & Orbs: Mounted upon each of his broad shoulders are large, spherical armored conduits—representing burning miniature suns—that continuously vent and regulate his overwhelming internal plasma heat.

Limbs & Stance: His forearms and greaves are heavily reinforced with sharp golden gauntlets and claw-tipped sabatons, built for brutal close-quarters combat and delivering superheated physical impacts.

Solar Halo & Mantle: A brilliant radiant ring of burning solar flares often hovers behind his back, pulsating in sync with his combat drive and casting an intense golden glow across the battlefield.

Key Weapons & Special Techniques

Sol Blaster: Charges and releases a massive, scorching sphere of high-density solar plasma generated from the flaming orbs on his back and shoulders, incinerating targets at atomic scale.

Phoebus Blow: Channels his entire body's internal solar heat directly into his fists, delivering a devastating, explosive punch imbued with the destructive kinetic and thermal force of an erupting sun.

Arrow of Apollo: Condenses blistering thermal energy at his fingertips to fire consecutive, light-speed piercing bolts of radiant plasma that track and impale distant foes.

Personality & Lore

Noble Discipline: Apollomon embodies strict martial pride, supreme honor, and an unwavering sense of justice, rarely losing his composure unless an ally is threatened.

Hidden Berserk Potential: Beneath his noble exterior lies a feral, primal flame
